criteria.question: Is the patient aged between 40 and 85 years?
Does the patient have a diagnosis of Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD)?
criteria.original_text: Participants with a physician diagnosis of Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD)

criteria.question: Is the patient a current or former smoker with a smoking history of at least 10 pack-years?
criteria.original_text: Current or former smokers with a smoking history of ≥10 pack-years

criteria.question: Does the record show a post-bronchodilator FEV1/FVC ratio less than 0.70?
criteria.original_text: Moderate-to-severe COPD (post-BD FEV1/FVC ratio <0.70 and post-BD FEV1 % predicted >30% and ≤70%)

criteria.question: Does the screening post-BD FEV1 % predicted fall between 30% and 70%?
criteria.original_text: Moderate-to-severe COPD (post-BD FEV1/FVC ratio <0.70 and post-BD FEV1 % predicted >30% and ≤70%)

criteria.question: Does the patient have a Medical Research Council Dyspnea Scale grade ≥2 or COPD assessment test (CAT) score ≥10?
criteria.original_text: Medical Research Council Dyspnea Scale grade ≥2 or COPD assessment test (CAT) score ≥10

criteria.question: Does the patient have a history of frequent or severe exacerbations (GOLD category E)?
criteria.original_text: Global Initiative for Chronic Obstructive Lung Disease (GOLD) category E , Frequent or severe exacerbations

criteria.question: Has the patient been on background triple therapy (ICS + LABA + LAMA) for 3 months with a stable dose for ≥1 month?
criteria.original_text: Background triple therapy (ICS + LABA + LAMA) for 3 months before randomization with a stable dose of medication for ≥1 month before Visit 1

criteria.question: Is dual therapy (LABA + LAMA) used because ICS is contraindicated?
criteria.original_text: dual therapy (LABA + LAMA) allowed if ICS is contraindicated

criteria.question: Does the patient have a history of blood eosinophils ≥300 cells/μL within the past year during stable state?
criteria.original_text: Evidence of Type 2 inflammation: Participants with blood eosinophils ≥300 cells/μL at screening or with blood eosinophils ≥150 cells/μL at Visit 1 (screening) and with a history of blood eosinophils ≥300 cells/μL within the past year during stable state (non-exacerbation).

criteria.question: Does the patient have blood eosinophils ≥300 cells/μL at screening or ≥150 cells/μL at Visit 1?
criteria.original_text: Evidence of Type 2 inflammation: Participants with blood eosinophils ≥300 cells/μL at screening or with blood eosinophils ≥150 cells/μL at Visit 1 (screening) and with a history of blood eosinophils ≥300 cells/μL within the past year during stable state (non-exacerbation).

criteria.question: Does the patient have a mucus score cutoff of ≥3?
Does the patient have a current or documented history of asthma?
criteria.original_text: A current diagnosis of asthma according to the Global Initiative for Asthma diagnostic (GINA) guidelines, or documented history of asthma

criteria.question: Does the patient have significant pulmonary disease other than COPD or another disease associated with elevated eosinophils?
criteria.original_text: Significant pulmonary disease other than COPD (eg, lung fibrosis, sarcoidosis, interstitial lung disease, pulmonary hypertension, bronchiectasis, Churg-Strauss Syndrome) or another diagnosed pulmonary or systemic disease associated with elevated peripheral eosinophil counts

criteria.question: Is the patient on treatment with oxygen >4.0 L/min for ≥8 hours/day?
criteria.original_text: Treatment with oxygen >4.0 L/min for ≥8 hours/day

criteria.question: Has the patient had a respiratory tract infection within 4 weeks before screening or during screening?
criteria.original_text: Respiratory tract infection within 4 weeks before screening, or during the screening period

criteria.question: Does the patient have a diagnosis of alpha-1 anti-trypsin deficiency?
Is the patient currently receiving any biologic therapy including experimental treatments and dupilumab?
criteria.original_text: Any biologic therapy (including experimental treatments and dupilumab)

criteria.question: Is the patient on treatment with mucolytics that have not been stable for >6 months?
criteria.original_text: Participants on treatment with mucolytics unless on stable therapy for >6 months
